build_distillation_modeling_hook: build a DistillationModelingHook from config to apply knowledge distillation to a student model
create_knowledge_distillation_algorithm: create a KnowledgeDistillation algorithm that computes layer-wise losses between student and teacher model outputs
create_domain_adaptation_algorithm: create a DomainAdaptation algorithm that applies loss over domain0 and domain1 inputs
create_pseudo_labeler: create a RelabelTargetInBatch pseudo labeler that replaces batch targets with teacher model outputs
create_default_loss_combiner: create a DefaultLossCombiner that returns a weighted sum of losses based on name_weight dictionary
